directive.quote: finish the film repository port so the repo can be retired: settings are rows in the person's lists, read through the door

preserve: every edit op of the spec keeps its FilmCraft commands and order: prepend first (frame-snapped, copy+insert of all tracks, overlap refused), cuts latest first, head_extend (ripple in-edge then the V2 out-edge), holds latest first on frames with the V2 grade trimmed over them (also at 0:00), a1_mute, gain, scale keyframes, hold_picture on V3 with the overlay then on V4, overlay.mov on V3 and sound.wav on A2 with fillFrame

the export is the one locked filmcraft_export into a per-option scratch in work-round-<n>/pending, mastered by two-pass loudnorm (picture copied, aac 256k, faststart), the scratch removed, the still from still_preview or still_at - preview start
main() takes the render lock itself; the project is a byte copy of the base project and is only written by FilmCraft (--save)
allowed_deltas: the option folder, layout, base project, lock, export format/scale/quality, loudness and still quality come from the film's list:settings row (option_folders.configure) where they were the film repository's folders, look_r3.json and literals
one JSON request in, the answer on the last line; plan mode records every command (FilmCraft's own commands run on a scratch copy) and runs nothing that writes
an optional overlay step calls tool:render-a-motion-graphics-overlay before the build; a relative hold_picture is read against the film
banned_substitutions: a film's folders, option ids, watch-folder names or the person's name written into the code
a second copy of the overlay renderer (the overlay step calls tool:render-a-motion-graphics-overlay)
an edit of the person's graded project other than FilmCraft's own headless commands on a copy

test_refs: tools/put-picked-options-into-a-filmcraft-project/test/test_cold_opens.py the stitched opening, the grade under it, the mutes, the hold picture and the overlay tracks
tools/put-picked-options-into-a-filmcraft-project/test/test_prepend.py copies keep their order, media and length; overlapping ranges refused
